scientific_question_cn: 同一 plain UNSB 在五域共享训练第一个 epoch 后，是否超出任务专用模型在本域曝光匹配和总优化步匹配下的早期方向几何包络？

data.aio_construction: hardlink union of the five frozen single-domain trainA/trainB views
data.heldout_selection: sort remaining stems by sha256(protocol_id|domain|stem), take first 20 per domain

comparison_table.exposure_matched: AIO epoch 1 vs Single epoch 1; both have 100 expected exposures for the focal domain
comparison_table.optimizer_clock_matched: AIO epoch 1 vs Single epoch 5; both have 500 total optimizer steps
comparison_table.age_envelope: AIO epoch 1 vs max dispersion across Single epochs 1..5

secondary_statistics: prefix Monte Carlo stability at M=8 and M=16 using the first proposals of the frozen M=32 panel
joint tangent-PCA coordinates for one hash-selected image per domain at bridge index 2

requirements_per_passing_time: age_envelope_excess domain mean > 0 in at least 4/5 domains

precommitted_fallback_interpretation.if_age_envelope_fails_but_exposure_and_c: Report dual-control fan-out but do not claim that AIO exceeds the entire Single early-age envelope.
precommitted_fallback_interpretation.if_only_exposure_passes: Treat the result as exposure-matched only and retain optimizer-age confounding.
precommitted_fallback_interpretation.if_all_fail: Report the fresh-seed negative result next to the historical six-seed evidence; do not tune samples, epochs, metric, or bridge times post hoc.

headfigure.title: Sharing one bridge changes the initial conditional direction field
panels: A: five task-specific bridges versus one shared bridge schematic using real held-out thumbnails
B: historical 6-seed x 5-domain Epoch-1 sign-consensus wall
C: fresh-seed domain forest for age-envelope excess
D: fresh-seed exposure/clock/envelope bridge-time curves with nested-bootstrap intervals
E: hash-selected per-domain joint tangent-PCA direction glyphs
headfigure.display_only_adjustments: ellipse short-axis floor allowed only in the separate diagnostic figure and must be labeled

forbidden_post_effect_changes: change M to rescue a sign
replace D_sph after reading the result
select a different checkpoint as the primary AIO observation
treat image bootstrap as training-seed confirmation
